title: Royal Albert Hall

terrainReference.basis: Dry north-front sidewalk beside the entrance porch, outside roof/stair projections and street carriageway.

note: Mapped five-stage elliptical red-brick/terracotta hall with recessed square/round upper windows, mosaic band, gridded radial dome and central lantern; three large arched N/E/W porches and smaller pedimented south porch. Nine inspected local originals, primary Historic England/MOLA2020building record and current aerial control proportions. Two unchanged Terrarium tiles, dry north sidewalk datum18.3328m/3m grid, fixed below-grade foundation-3m. Fine trim/frieze relief and thresholds are approximate. Footprint replacement disabled.
